---
title: "Background Noise"

::: {.function-badge}
[Spillover](../function/spillover.qmd)
:::

Persistent low-level repetition of regime-aligned messages—across entertainment, commentary, or casual discourse—creates ambient familiarity that normalizes falsehoods and weakens audience skepticism. This slow-drip exposure shapes perception even without persuasion.
